registers.name: qspi_ctrl
registers.description: QSPI control register. Starts a manual flash transaction and selects its operation.

fields.name: go
fields.description:
Manual operation launch request. A rising write requests the shared serial engine to start the configured transaction.

Usage: Software sets this bit after programming the command and data parameters; hardware clears it when the launch pulse is accepted.

Values:
0x0 No manual launch request;
0x1 Request one manual operation.

Unit: none.

Limits: A request while the engine is busy is not queued.

fields.name: op_sel
spare_lo
fields.description:
Unused control storage. Writes are retained and returned by reads but do not control the engine.

Usage: Software should write zero; the serial engine ignores this field.

Values:
0x0 Recommended value;
0x1 to 0x1F Stored but ignored.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: fifo_clr
fields.description:
FIFO clear level. When high, it continuously clears both transmit and receive FIFOs.

Usage: Software writes one to clear the FIFOs and writes zero afterward to release them.

Values:
0x0 FIFOs are not cleared by this control;
0x1 Hold both FIFOs in clear.

Unit: none.

Limits: This bit is level-sensitive and does not self-clear.

fields.name: spare_hi
fields.description:
Unused control storage. Writes are retained and returned by reads but do not control the engine.

Usage: Software should write zero; the serial engine ignores this field.

Values:
0x0 Recommended value;
0x1 to 0x7FFFFF Stored but ignored.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: qspi_sts
registers.description: QSPI live status register. Reports busy, completion, error, FIFO and XIP activity.

fields.name: busy
fields.description:
Engine busy indication. It reflects whether the serial command engine is processing a transaction.

Usage: Software polls this bit before starting a manual command or changing active configuration.

Values:
0x0 Engine is idle;
0x1 Engine is processing a transaction.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Completion indication. It reflects the sticky done event stored in the interrupt status register.

Usage: Software reads this bit to observe completion and clears the cause through the interrupt status register.

Values:
0x0 No completion event is recorded;
0x1 Completion event is recorded.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: err
fields.description:
Live error indication. It reflects the serial engine error input, not the sticky interrupt error cause.

Usage: Software may sample this bit during error handling and should also read the interrupt status register.

Values:
0x0 No current engine error indication;
0x1 Engine error input is asserted.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tx_empty
fields.description:
Transmit FIFO empty indication. It is high when no byte is available for the serial engine to consume.

Usage: Software checks this bit when loading transmit data and before starting a program operation.

Values:
0x0 At least one transmit byte is available;
0x1 Transmit FIFO contains no byte.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rx_valid
fields.description:
Receive data available indication. It is high when the receive FIFO contains a byte for software.

Usage: Software checks this bit before reading RXDATA; a valid RXDATA read pops one byte.

Values:
0x0 No receive byte is available;
0x1 At least one receive byte is available.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: xip_active
fields.description:
Execute-in-place activity indication. It reflects an active memory-mapped flash read transaction.

Usage: Software uses this bit to avoid starting a manual command while XIP owns the shared engine.

Values:
0x0 No XIP transaction is active;
0x1 An XIP transaction is active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: qspi_clkdiv
registers.description: QSPI clock divider register. Stores the divider value used to derive serial clock timing.

fields.name: div_val
fields.description:
Serial clock divider value. The low sixteen bits feed the engine and determine the SCLK toggle interval.

Usage: Software selects a divider compatible with the controller clock and flash timing.

Values:
0x0 Fastest divider setting;
0x1 to 0xFFFF Increasing values reduce SCLK frequency.

Unit: controller clock cycles.

Limits: Only bits 15 through 0 affect the engine; maximum SCLK is TBD by flash and implementation timing.

registers.name: qspi_mode
registers.description: QSPI lane mode register. Selects single, dual or quad serial data lanes.

fields.name: lane_mode

registers.name: qspi_cmd
registers.description: QSPI command register. Holds the eight-bit opcode transmitted for a manual command.

fields.name: opcode
fields.description:
Flash command opcode. The low byte is shifted to the flash at the start of a manual transfer.

Usage: Software writes an opcode supported by the attached flash before asserting go.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF Opcode byte value.

Unit: none.

Limits: Only bits 7 through 0 reach the engine; command framing is fixed by RTL.

registers.name: qspi_flash_addr
registers.description: QSPI flash address register. Supplies the manual transaction address.

fields.name: addr_val
fields.description:
Flash byte address for a manual operation. The engine shifts three address bytes in most-significant-byte first order.

Usage: Software programs the address before starting a read, program or erase command.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFF Address range representable by three emitted bytes;
0x1000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF Stored but upper address bits are not emitted.

Unit: bytes.

Limits: The implemented serial address phase is 24 bits.

registers.name: qspi_len
registers.description: QSPI length register. Stores the requested manual transaction data length.

fields.name: len_val
fields.description:
Manual data length value. The low sixteen bits are passed to the engine as its byte-count value.

Usage: Software sets a length appropriate to the selected operation before starting it.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFF Byte count supplied to the engine.

Unit: bytes.

Limits: Only bits 15 through 0 affect the engine.

registers.name: qspi_dummy
registers.description: QSPI dummy-cycle register. Stores dummy cycles inserted in read phases.

fields.name: dummy_val
fields.description:
Dummy-cycle count inserted between address or mode phases and received data.

Usage: Software programs the value required by the target flash command profile.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF Dummy-cycle count.

Unit: SCLK cycles.

Limits: Only bits 7 through 0 affect the engine; target-flash dependent.

registers.name: qspi_txdata
registers.description: QSPI transmit data register. Writing the low byte pushes one byte into the transmit FIFO.

fields.name: tx_byte
fields.description:
Transmit FIFO input byte. A valid write using byte lane zero pushes this byte into the FIFO.

Usage: Software fills the FIFO before a program operation and refills it while the engine consumes data.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF Byte pushed to the transmit FIFO.

Unit: bytes.

Limits: The source has no readable TXDATA register; rw is an inventory approximation because the generator has no write-only type.

registers.name: qspi_rxdata
registers.description: QSPI receive data register. Reading the low byte pops one received byte when available.

fields.name: rx_byte
fields.description:
Receive FIFO output byte. A valid read returns the oldest received byte and removes it from the FIFO.

Usage: Software checks rx_valid before reading this register to consume data.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF Received byte value.

Unit: bytes.

Limits: An empty-FIFO read returns zero and does not pop; data is valid only when rx_valid is high.

registers.name: qspi_irq_en
registers.description: QSPI interrupt enable register. Masks completion and error causes onto the IRQ output.

fields.name: done_en
fields.description:
Completion interrupt mask. Enables the done sticky cause to contribute to the external IRQ output.

Usage: Software sets this bit after configuring the handler and clears it to mask completion interrupts.

Values:
0x0 Completion interrupt masked;
0x1 Completion interrupt enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: err_en
fields.description:
Error interrupt mask. Enables the error sticky cause to contribute to the external IRQ output.

Usage: Software sets this bit after configuring the handler and clears it to mask error interrupts.

Values:
0x0 Error interrupt masked;
0x1 Error interrupt enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: spare
fields.description:
Unused interrupt-mask storage. Writes are retained but no event source is connected to these bits.

Usage: Software should write zero; only the two defined mask bits affect IRQ.

Values:
0x0 Recommended value;
0x1 to 0x3FFFFFFF Stored but ignored.

Unit: none.

Limits: No interrupt source is associated with these bits.

registers.name: qspi_irq_sts
registers.description: QSPI interrupt status register. Contains sticky completion and error event causes cleared by writing one.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Completion event latch. Hardware sets this bit when the shared serial engine reports transaction completion.

Usage: Software reads the cause and writes one to clear it after servicing completion.

Values:
0x0 No completion event is pending;
0x1 Completion event is pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: err
fields.description:
Error event latch. Hardware sets this bit for an engine error or either FIFO full condition.

Usage: Software reads the cause and writes one to clear it after servicing the error condition.

Values:
0x0 No error event is pending;
0x1 Error event is pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: qspi_version
registers.description: QSPI version register. Returns a constant implementation revision identifier.

fields.name: version
fields.description:
Implementation version value. Reads return the compile-time version constant and writes are not accepted.

Usage: Software may read this field during bring-up to identify the register-map implementation.

Values:
0x00010000 Version constant reported by this source revision.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: qspi_xip_ctrl
registers.description: QSPI XIP control register. Enables the read-only memory-mapped flash window.

fields.name: en
fields.description:
XIP window enable. When set, address hits on the configured window can request flash reads.

Usage: Software configures base, mask and command before setting this bit.

Values:
0x0 XIP window disabled;
0x1 XIP window enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: spare
fields.description:
Unused XIP control storage. Writes are retained but do not affect XIP operation.

Usage: Software should write zero; the XIP interface uses only bit zero.

Values:
0x0 Recommended value;
0x1 to 0x7FFFFFFF Stored but ignored.

Unit: none.

Limits: Only bit zero controls XIP.

registers.name: qspi_xip_base
registers.description: QSPI XIP base register. Stores the base address used for XIP window matching.

fields.name: base_addr
fields.description:
Host address base used by masked XIP matching and subtraction to generate the flash offset.

Usage: Software aligns this value with the selected XIP window and mask.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF Host address base value.

Unit: bytes.

Limits: Base alignment and legal mask patterns are not validated.

registers.name: qspi_xip_mask
registers.description: QSPI XIP mask register. Selects host address bits that participate in window matching.

fields.name: addr_mask
fields.description:
Address comparison mask used to decide whether a host read falls inside the XIP window.

Usage: Software programs a contiguous window mask consistent with the base address.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF Address decode mask value.

Unit: address bits.

Limits: Mask contiguity and base alignment are not checked.

registers.name: qspi_xip_cmd
registers.description: QSPI XIP command register. Holds the opcode used for memory-mapped flash reads.

fields.name: opcode
fields.description:
XIP read opcode. The low byte is sent as the command phase for an accepted memory-mapped read.

Usage: Software selects an opcode compatible with the selected flash and lane mode.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF Opcode byte value.

Unit: none.

Limits: Only bits 7 through 0 reach the engine.

registers.name: qspi_xip_mode
registers.description: QSPI XIP mode register. Controls optional mode-byte transmission for continuous-read profiles.

fields.name: mode_byte
fields.description:
Mode byte transmitted after the address phase when mode-byte enable is set.

Usage: Software configures this field for the selected flash command profile.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFF Mode-byte value.

Unit: none.

Limits: The byte is emitted only when bit eight is set.

fields.name: mode_en
fields.description:
Mode-byte phase enable. Selects whether XIP includes the configured mode byte after the address phase.

Usage: Software enables this only when the chosen flash command requires a mode byte.

Values:
0x0 Do not transmit a mode byte;
0x1 Transmit the configured mode byte.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: spare
fields.description:
Unused XIP mode storage. Writes are retained but bits above the mode enable do not affect the engine.

Usage: Software should write zero to this field.

Values:
0x0 Recommended value;
0x1 to 0x7FFFFF Stored but ignored.

Unit: none.

Limits: No operation is assigned to these bits.
